# Quinta Casa da Adega

> Wedding venue (quinta para casamentos) in Gradil, Mafra, near Lisbon, Portugal. The estate is dedicated exclusively to weddings and hosts only 15 weddings a year, one wedding per day. Website in Portuguese (pt-PT) and English (en-GB).

## Key facts

- Type: wedding venue / quinta para casamentos (weddings only)
- Address: Rua das Forças Armadas, 34, 2665-118 Gradil, Mafra, Portugal
- Area: municipality of Mafra (Lisbon district), near Lisbon, Sintra and Ericeira
- Exclusivity: only 15 weddings a year, a single wedding per day
- Setting: countryside estate with a natural setting and a view of São Silvestre Church
- Ceremony: outdoor ceremony in the garden; an elegant plan B is prepared for any weather
- Services: table decoration, floral design, catering and planning, with a specialist team
- Visits: private visits to the estate, with no obligation
- Quotes: bespoke proposal within 24–48 hours, via the proposal request form or WhatsApp
- International couples: several couples have planned their wedding from abroad (destination weddings in Portugal)
- History: a gathering place since the 1980s; acquired by the current family in 2018; in 2024 the family decided to dedicate it exclusively to weddings
- Phone / WhatsApp: +351 913 733 457
- Email: hello@quintacasadaadega.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/quintacasadaadega
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/QuintaCasadaAdega/

Not published by the venue (do not assume): guest capacity, prices.
